# ---------------------------------------
# Funções auxiliares
# ---------------------------------------

def read_sql(query):
    return pd.read_sql(query, engine)

def read_gdf(query, geom_col="geom"):
    return gpd.read_postgis(query, engine, geom_col=geom_col)

def anonymise_station_labels(df, id_col="id_charging_station", label_col="station_label"):
    """
        Creates anonymised station labels for sensivel data
    """
    df_out = df.copy()

    df_out[label_col] = [
        f"CS{i:03d}"
        for i in range(1, len(df_out) + 1)
    ]

    return df_out

# ---------------------------------------------
# Caracterização da infraestrutura instalada
# ---------------------------------------------
""" 
Objetivo:
    caracterizar a dimensão e distribuição da rede Mobie existente (apenas no Continente). Esta análise complemente a procura observada, permitindo compreender a 
    capacidade instalada disponível em termos de pontos de carregamento, EVSE, conectores e potência de carregamento (tipo de carregador - rápido, super-rápido, ...)

Input
    v20_oferta_posto

Indicadores
    número de pontos de carregamento
    número de EVSE 
    potência total instalada
    potência média por ponto de carregamento
"""

summary = read_sql(""" 
    SELECT 
        COUNT(id_charging_station) AS n_postos,
        SUM(n_evse) AS n_evse_total,
        SUM(n_conectores) AS n_conectores_total,
        SUM(potencia_total_kw) AS potencia_total_instalada_kw,
        AVG(potencia_total_kw) AS potencia_media_por_posto_kw,
        AVG(potencia_media_kw) AS potencia_media_por_conector_kw
    FROM v20_oferta_posto
""")

summary

# ---------------------------------------------
# Comparação global procura vs oferta
# ---------------------------------------------
procura_vs_oferta =read_sql("""
        SELECT
            COUNT(o.id_charging_station) AS n_pontos_instalados,
            COUNT(p.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_com_procura,
            COUNT(o.id_charging_station) - COUNT(p.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_sem_procura,
            COUNT(p.id_charging_station)::numeric / COUNT(o.id_charging_station) AS pct_postos_com_procura,
            (COUNT(o.id_charging_station) - COUNT(p.id_charging_station))::numeric / COUNT(o.id_charging_station) AS pct_postos_sem_procura
        FROM v20_oferta_posto o LEFT JOIN v14_procura_posto_clean p ON o.id_charging_station = p.id_charging_station
        """)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Percentagem de postos em procura por distrito (percentagem)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

postos_sem_procura_pct = read_sql("""
SELECT
    o.distrito,
    COUNT(*) AS n_postos_instalados,
    COUNT(p.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_com_procura,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(p.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_sem_procura,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (COUNT(*) - COUNT(p.id_charging_station))
        / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS pct_sem_procura
FROM v20_oferta_posto o
LEFT JOIN v14_procura_posto_clean p
    ON o.id_charging_station = p.id_charging_station
GROUP BY o.distrito
ORDER BY pct_sem_procura DESC
""")

        o.distrito,
        COUNT(o.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_instalados,

"""
    média EVSE
    média conectores

 """
comparacao = read_sql("""
    SELECT
        grupo,
        AVG(n_evse) AS media_evse,
        AVG(n_conectores) AS media_conectores,
        AVG(potencia_total_kw) AS potencia_media_kw,
        AVG(potencia_max_kw) AS potencia_max_media_kw,
        AVG(tem_dc) AS pct_dc,
        AVG(tem_rapido) AS pct_rapido
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            'Com procura' AS grupo
        FROM v20_oferta_posto
        WHERE id_charging_station IN (
            SELECT id_charging_station
            FROM v14_procura_posto_clean
        )

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            *,
            'Sem procura' AS grupo
        FROM v51_postos_sem_procura
    ) x
    GROUP BY grupo
""")
comparacao

# --------------------------------------------------
# Distribuição municipal :: distrito de Coimbra
# --------------------------------------------------

munic_analisar = read_sql(f"""
    SELECT
        o.municipio,
        COUNT(o.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_instalados,
        COUNT(p.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_com_procura,
        COUNT(o.id_charging_station) - COUNT(p.id_charging_station) AS n_postos_sem_procura,
        SUM(o.n_evse) AS n_evse,
        SUM(o.n_conectores) AS n_conectores,
        SUM(o.potencia_total_kw) AS potencia_total_kw
    FROM v20_oferta_posto o
    LEFT JOIN v14_procura_posto_clean p
        ON o.id_charging_station = p.id_charging_station
    WHERE UPPER(o.distrito) = UPPER('{DISTRITO}')
    GROUP BY o.municipio
    ORDER BY n_postos_instalados DESC
    """)
